mentions.claim_text: He says Cuba is coming and about to be liberated, that he keeps praying over it, and asks whether there is anything else breaking worth showing.
mentions.quote: Cuba's about to be liberated. I keep praying over
mentions.falsify_match: The Cuban government falls.

mentions.claim_text: He works out Cuba's dimensions with his co-host and notes that the intelligence director visited Cuba, asking what he is doing there.
mentions.quote: CIA Director John Ratcliffe visits Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: An American operation on Cuba follows the visit.

mentions.claim_text: He sings the Battle Hymn and says that when he sings it the Lord told him he is not done with America yet.
mentions.quote: I'm not done with America yet, Brandon
mentions.falsify_match: A national religious resurgence.

mentions.claim_text: He says the sky is not falling, that a shaking to awaken is coming, and that the greatest revival is yet to happen, greater than any great awakening.
mentions.quote: the greatest revival is yet to happen. Greater than any of the great awakening
mentions.falsify_match: A movement exceeding the historic awakenings.

mentions.claim_text: He says God will shake Hawaii, New York, Florida and California, that the greatest harvest is yet to happen, and that it is time for the church to rise with a backbone like a crowbar.
mentions.quote: It's time for the church to rise UP WITH A BACKBONE LIKE A CROWBAR
mentions.falsify_match: Major events in all four named states.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that he sees a rebirthing across America, a baby rebirthing, that it will come to pass, and that he sees the founding fathers.
mentions.quote: I SEE A baby is rebirthing across America
mentions.falsify_match: A national renewal on the anniversary.

mentions.claim_text: He says a cleansing is coming to the church and God is dealing with the sin behind the pulpits because judgment begins in his house, that a rebirthing comes out of it, and that America will be shaken and saved and will remain a sheep nation rather than a goat nation.
mentions.quote: I'm dealing with the sin behind THE PULPITS
mentions.falsify_match: A run of church scandals followed by growth.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great shaking and a great earthquake are yet to happen in British Columbia with many more after it, and that they will be trying to separate.
mentions.quote: a great shaking in British Columbia. A great earthquake is yet to happen
mentions.falsify_match: A major British Columbia earthquake followed by secession politics.

mentions.claim_text: He says the same will happen in England and in certain places in Japan, and that the Catholic Church and the Vatican will shake.
mentions.quote: it will be when the Catholic Church is going to shake
mentions.falsify_match: Upheaval in the Catholic Church and earthquakes at those places.

mentions.claim_text: He prays a hedge around the decisions being made over Iran and the strait, and says there is going to be a great breakthrough concerning the strait.
mentions.quote: There's going to be a great breakthrough concerning the strait
mentions.falsify_match: A negotiated settlement over the strait.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will then be Cuba's turn, that he hears a breakthrough coming in the strait, and that China will be involved in it.
mentions.quote: then it will be Cuba's turn. China is going to be involved
mentions.falsify_match: A strait settlement with Chinese involvement followed by American action on Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He says the president is going to make his own chips and they do not need Taiwan, that he is only saying what he heard, that they must pray for the people of Taiwan, and that he fears God not man.
mentions.quote: Trump's going to make his own chips. We don't need Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: American chip capacity displaces Taiwanese dependence.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He flags that the statement will be unpopular rather than softening it.

mentions.claim_text: He sings that he will sing praises to God's name because his name is great and greatly to be praised.
mentions.quote: for your name is great and greatly to be praised
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a sung passage.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He rejects the idea that the two parties will simply become friends and get along, and says a church will rise with a backbone like a crowbar and that the church does not represent a country.
mentions.quote: the church doesn't represent a country
mentions.falsify_match: A church movement that is not aligned to a party.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. Notable as a de-politicising statement from a heavily political broadcast.

mentions.claim_text: He talks about accuracy in how he hears and sees so that people can catch it, says some are dull about the revival, and that he does not look at the church as America or Asia.
mentions.quote: I don't look at the church as America
mentions.falsify_match: His claims stay accurate and specific.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is taking down the denominational barriers between Baptists, Methodists, Catholics and Episcopalians, that they will function as a body, and that it did not involve a government.
mentions.quote: God's taken down denominational barriers between Baptists, Methodists
mentions.falsify_match: A visible cross denominational movement.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that no weapon formed against them will prosper and that a thousand shall fall at their side, covering the president, the secretary of state, a named candidate and the vice president.
mentions.quote: A thousand shall fall at their side, 10,000 at their right hand
mentions.falsify_match: No harm comes to those named.
mentions.falsify_miss: Harm comes to one of them.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man stood and was not moving though he was trying, with antichrist and Jezebel spirits coming against him and octopus tentacles trying to wrap around his mind.
mentions.quote: I saw tentacles of octopus trying to wrap around his mind
mentions.falsify_match: A decision he later reverses as a mistake.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The claim concerns spirits, so it cannot be checked directly.

mentions.claim_text: He says Democrats were talking to Canada and devising a plan, that he can show the video, and that he saw something very dark about the meeting which had not yet taken place.
mentions.quote: Democrats were talking to Canada and they were devising a plan
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated American opposition and Canadian initiative emerges.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw things being presented to the president which he marks as symbolic, that he saw the French president and lineages of people, that he does not know what it means and his mouth dried, and prays as the president travels to China.
mentions.quote: I saw lineages of people. I thought what is that?
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to an identifiable presentation.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; he says he does not know.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw plane after plane flying over Cuba and that the Lord said they are looking for nuclear and radioactive devices but they are encased in thick lead.
mentions.quote: They're looking for nuclear and radioactive devices, but they're encased in lead
mentions.falsify_match: A shielded device is found in Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a lot of flights circling Cuba and says the sniffers will not be able to smell the devices, adding that he does not know what lead would do.
mentions.quote: I don't know what lead would do
mentions.falsify_match: Shielded material is found despite the flights.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He states his own uncertainty about the physics.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the case as one you push buttons on the top to latch, with a key to lock it, like something from the 1970s, and says his grandmother had them and that he does not know what it is.
mentions.quote: It was encased in a thing like the 70s
mentions.falsify_match: A device of that era and form is found.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He has dated the same object to the 1960s elsewhere.

mentions.claim_text: He says oil refineries are going up everywhere as the Lord told them, that it will try to send oil to two hundred dollars a barrel, that this is not financial advice and only his opinion, and that he saw gas lines like the 1970s.
mentions.quote: He said it will try to send oil to $200 a barrel
mentions.falsify_match: Oil above two hundred dollars with fuel queues.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is serious when a government tells people to stay home from work and starts imposing pandemic style restrictions, and turns to a report about the Israeli prime minister.
mentions.quote: whenever you tell your people to stay home from work
mentions.falsify_match: New lockdown style restrictions are imposed.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why a figure would step down after meeting the king and what kind of scandal it would take, and turns to a report on the Russian president and Ukraine.
mentions.quote: why would he just step down? What kind of scandal?
mentions.falsify_match: A scandal produces a resignation.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was asked which conflict would stop first and heard by the spirit that Ukraine and Russia will stop first, not Iran.
mentions.quote: Ukraine and Russia has will stop first. Not Iran
mentions.falsify_match: The Ukraine war ends before the Iran conflict.
mentions.falsify_miss: Iran settles first, which is what the June 2026 ceasefire did.

mentions.claim_text: His co-host points out the lavender fields, and he confirms it was lavender he was looking at over Russia and that lavender brings peace when you breathe it in.
mentions.quote: It was lavender that you were looking at over Russia
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian peace.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The lavender identification is supplied by his co-host from footage.

mentions.claim_text: He calls peace over Russia and Ukraine, says cool heads will prevail, and calls the war to stop and cease and for them to come to an agreement.
mentions.quote: We call the war to stop and cease in the name of Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: A ceasefire and agreement.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will be pro-Russia and pro-Ukraine, calls peace again, and says he does not know whether Russia is known for lavender but he can smell it.
mentions.quote: I don't know if Russia is known for lavender, but I smell it
mentions.falsify_match: A partition settlement acceptable to both.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He says he does not know whether the detail fits the country.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that he can smell lavender and that it was what was growing over that land.
mentions.quote: it's what was growing over that land
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian peace or religious movement.

mentions.claim_text: He sees purple, stars and what look like diamonds on the breath as the people of Russia breathe deeply, like a sigh of relief.
mentions.quote: I see what would look like diamonds on the breathe
mentions.falsify_match: Relief in Russia following an end to the war.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Turkey and that it is not satisfied but stirred up, and that he could hear music playing in the spirit while praying.
mentions.quote: I see Turkey and he's not satisfied. He's stirred up
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey acts against a settlement.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know what he is seeing and is only telling it as it comes, that he sees pockets of people praying for peace because of the blood shed over Ukraine.
mentions.quote: I don't know what I'm seeing. I'm just telling you as I see it
mentions.falsify_match: A prayer movement in Russia.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. He flags his own uncertainty first, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says to remember the provoking, that they see in part, that they will see the peace and then a major weapon never used before over Poland, and that he saw them trying to use long range missiles.
mentions.quote: you see the peace and then you see a major weapon used
mentions.falsify_match: A peace followed by a novel weapon strike on Poland.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs. The peace then war sequence means a ceasefire confirms rather than refutes it.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether it could happen in months or after four years, says he does not know, and that he believes the Russian president gets a reprieve to rebuild the military with missiles before starting again.
mentions.quote: Could it happen after four years? I don't know
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian pause followed by rearmament and a fresh offensive.
mentions.falsify_miss: No pause, or a permanent peace. The range he gives spans months to four years.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a man negotiating behind two tables and an agreement reached in the days ahead concerning the Clarity Act, with handshakes, while the head of a named bank was throwing a fit.
mentions.quote: they came to an agreement in the days ahead concerning the Clarity Act
mentions.falsify_match: A negotiated agreement on the crypto bill over bank objections.

mentions.claim_text: He names Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo and other major banks as present and objecting to the Clarity Act, says it is happening just as the Lord said, and that for decades these banks have treated people a certain way.
mentions.quote: they were throwing a fit about the Clarity Act
mentions.falsify_match: Documented bank lobbying against the bill.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is documented. The same four banks are named across several separate claims in this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not looking at the golden statue and thinks that part is bad, and that he pushes anything that looks like false idols or golden calf material far away from himself.
mentions.quote: anything that looks like false idols and golden calf stuff
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a statement of his own position.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says they should keep an archive of the big words so they do not get buried inside two and three hour broadcasts.
mentions.quote: keep an archives of some things of the big words
mentions.falsify_match: An archive is produced.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. Worth recording because a durable index is what would make the claims checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says he stands on the word and believes he is healed, and that the plague of three hundred and fifty million he was warned about was not America and not one nation out of all of them.
mentions.quote: the 350 million was not America
mentions.falsify_match: A global pandemic of that scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He clarifies the scope, which narrows the claim rather than widening it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them a named broadcaster would be a John the Baptist figure, that another's heart would turn from grey to black and he would stand against, and that a third would go down the rabbit hole and act erratically.
mentions.quote: Tucker Carlson's heart will turn from gray to black
mentions.falsify_match: Those three named figures move in the directions described.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them the refineries would start burning and the oil wells would be on fire, that they are in the news on fire, and that he said interest rates would explode.
mentions.quote: They're going to start burning their refineries
mentions.falsify_match: Refinery fires continue and interest rates rise sharply.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Refinery strikes were already the established pattern of the war by this date.

mentions.claim_text: He lists watch Cuba, the panda, a biological green weapon coming out of the water with a Russian submarine, and someone manipulating the Ukrainian president with a Pinocchio nose to fire rockets at the Vatican.
mentions.quote: that biological green weapon coming out of the water
mentions.falsify_match: A biological weapon delivered by submarine, or a strike on the Vatican.

mentions.claim_text: He says he will start to manipulate Canada, that there will be a black swan event over Europe which he is still looking for, mentions the Eiffel Tower and prayer over the Olympics, and that something will happen with people going down the ski slopes.
mentions.quote: There will be a black swan event over Europe and I'm still looking for that
mentions.falsify_match: An incident on the Olympic ski slopes.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He says plainly he is still waiting on the black swan, which is an open ledger entry.

mentions.claim_text: He prays Psalm 23, that goodness and mercy follow them all their days and that God prepares a table before them in the presence of their enemies.
mentions.quote: you prepare a table before us in the presence of all our enemies
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a psalm.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He calls revival over the nation from the Gulf to Canada, starting with the pastors and church leadership, and asks whether these bones can live across America, Europe and Australia.
mentions.quote: Can these bones live across America, ACROSS EUROPE, ACROSS AUSTRALIA
mentions.falsify_match: Church renewal across those three regions.

mentions.claim_text: He says he went from Berlin to something tied to the church, sees a shaking happen in California again, and sees little teeth nipping up from the ground that look like plants.
mentions.quote: there's these little teeth that are nipping from the ground
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; no reading is offered.

mentions.claim_text: He greets viewers late at night and asks where they are watching from, with Louisiana and Hong Kong called out.
mentions.quote: Tell us where you're from
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; an opening greeting.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord did not tell him to store a sack of potatoes but is telling his father to, and that each person has to follow what God is telling them to do, which is why he raises end time preparation.
mentions.quote: you have to follow the voice of God for what He's telling you to do
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; instruction on preparation.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; individualising it means no outcome tests it.

mentions.claim_text: He says leaders in California will fall and there will be a great church shaking there, that a major leader of a major Californian church will be shaken and things will be exposed.
mentions.quote: A major leader of a major church in California will be shaken
mentions.falsify_match: A named Californian megachurch leader falls in a scandal.

mentions.claim_text: He gives a word of rebuke that they say they want the revival and the glory but have too much of the world in them, with an instruction to separate themselves to see the great glory, and says a remnant have already done so.
mentions.quote: Separate yourself unto me and you will see the great glory
mentions.falsify_match: A visible change in the movement's conduct.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The condition means an absent revival is attributable to the hearers.

mentions.claim_text: He covers the nations represented in the audience, prays revival over Australia and thanks God that the Senate does not do something he begins to name.
mentions.quote: We pray for revival over Australia
mentions.falsify_match: An Australian revival.

mentions.claim_text: He prays protection around the Taiwanese people and over Korea, covering their houses and finances and rebuking the devourer.
mentions.quote: We pray over a protection around and about the Taiwanese people
mentions.falsify_match: Taiwan remains free through the period.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw them pushing worm burgers and getting ready to push cricket burgers as an alternative meat source over the United States.
mentions.quote: I saw them getting ready to push cricket burgers
mentions.falsify_match: Insect protein products are pushed into the American mainstream.
